audit_items.proof_trace: No snowflake regex validation exists anywhere on the call chain: syncRoles performs only a truthiness check (line 12-13), assignRole/removeRole likewise, and getMember (discord.ts:47-58) passes the raw string directly to guild.members.fetch(). The property /^\d{17,20}$/ is entirely absent. Exploitability is limited by required Bearer token auth, and discord.js gracefully returns null on invalid IDs, but an authenticated caller can still abuse Discord API rate limits or inject into logs (rolesSync.ts:206).
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker holding the API_AUTH_TOKEN bearer secret sends POST /api/roles/sync with a crafted discord_uid (e.g., containing newlines or a tight loop of invalid IDs), injecting entries into structured logs and exhausting the bot's Discord API rate-limit quota without the server crashing.
